messages.subject: Series C - getting started
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Sarah,

Good to speak yesterday. As discussed, we're moving ahead with the Series C and Marisdale Growth Partners are lining up to lead at around £30m new money on a £120m pre. We'd like Whitfield Carter to act for the company again, same team as Kestrel if possible.

Can you get an NDA across to them and start thinking about the term sheet? Their lead is Eleanor Whitmore.

Best,
Henry

messages.subject: Re: Series C - getting started
messages.plaintextBody:
Henry,

Delighted - and yes, James and Elena will pick this up with me. I'll send the mutual NDA to Marisdale today and we'll have a first-draft term sheet to you by the end of next week reflecting the £120m pre / £30m headline. We'll keep the same governance architecture from Kestrel as the starting point.

I'll also open the matter file (Project Lyra).

Kind regards,
Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
